top_categories.workout_context: The Gralloch's More than 80% gravel, Galloway Forest Park tracks forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 69 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Gralloch's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
5,778ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Gralloch, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
84ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At The Gralloch, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on galloway Forest Park gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
69 miles on galloway Forest Park gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Gralloch. Train it until it feels boring.
5,778ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Smooth pedaling at 69 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,778ft of climbing on galloway Forest Park gravel does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for The Gralloch’s 69 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at The Gralloch demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride galloway forest park gravel at race-day cadence weekly. Expect: more than 80% gravel, galloway forest park tracks, repeated short climbs. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Dial in tire pressure before race week — 5 PSI wrong costs you 15+ minutes over 69 miles.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 69 miles of galloway forest park gravel in Gatehouse of Fleet, Dumfries and Galloway, Scotland.
